## Mathematical shape
Design FR-19 rows 1–12 and B-leaves B1–B5 are preserved. The lattice line is closed locally: dual lattice/covolume → tiling → character orthogonality → smooth periodisation → coefficients → lattice Poisson (Schwartz) → two-sided-decay Poisson → comb duality (general Λ) → sampling = dual-lattice periodisation → band-limited sample coefficients → Shannon \(L^2\) theorem (locally uniform only under \(\sum_k|f(hk)|<\infty\)) → Nyquist no-aliasing. Five `local_addition` items supply what the design presupposes (sinc definition, linear substitutions on \(\mathcal S\), tiling at Countable-Choice strength, lattice orthogonality, lattice Fourier uniqueness).
